motions.name: Plasma forge work
motions.observation: A smith works a plasma forge: dials in the heat, hauls a hydraulic press lever, then hones the piece.
motions.interpretation: A looping standing work cycle at a console. Weight stays planted while the hands twist a heat dial, pull a press lever down with a lean, and stroke a hone across the piece. Used for every Smithery craft and quick craft.

motions.name: Circuit bench work
motions.observation: An engineer leans over a circuit board and works it with a probe.
motions.interpretation: A looping close-work cycle. The chest tips forward over the bench, the left hand steadies the board and the right hand taps test points, then drags a solder line. Used for every Engineering craft and quick craft.

motions.name: Fabricator console work
motions.observation: An operator runs a three-head fabricator from its control panel.
motions.interpretation: A looping console cycle. The torso turns to each tool head in turn, a hand presses its key, and both hands push the feed sliders forward at the centre. Used for every Fabrication craft and quick craft.

motions.name: Kitchen work
motions.observation: A cook stirs a pot and seasons it with a pinch.
motions.interpretation: A looping galley cycle. The right hand stirs a steady circle at waist height while the left hand holds the pot, lifts for a pinch of seasoning and flicks it over the pot. Used for every cooking craft and quick craft.

motions.name: Reaction bench work
motions.observation: A saboteur drips a reagent into a vial and holds it up to read the reaction.
motions.interpretation: A looping bench cycle. The right hand drips from a dropper into a vial held in the left, the vial lifts to eye level to check the colour, then returns for another drop. Used for every Espionage craft and quick craft.
